title: Good variety of snacks
text:
There is a nice variety of items in this box. I will get at least the second shipment and decide from there whether I want to continue the subscription. The box arrived a bit damaged and had mostly fallen apart within the first day I had it. I don’t care because I bought it for myself, but I would have been disappointed had I bought it for someone as a gift.

Update: I love the red bean donuts way more than I had expected to. Delicious! I wish I could order more of those.
label: positive
